quick_wins.name: Quick Wins
quick_wins.description: Zero-blocking fixes with immediate ROI. All tasks parallelizable.

medium.name: Medium-Term
medium.description: Core optimizations (quantization, paging, profiling). Most parallelizable, integration test at end.

long_term.name: Long-Term
long_term.description: Advanced features (distributed, LoRA, MoE, speculative). More sequential, depends on medium phase.

tasks.title: Fix LFM cache disposal memory leak
tasks.description: Uncomment cache.dispose() calls in lfm.ts (lines 114-115, 126) to prevent memory accumulation during inference loop.
tasks.entry_criteria: Cache disposal calls at lines 114-115, 126 are commented out (// cache.dispose())
tasks.exit_criteria: Uncommented disposal calls; memory stable over 100 inference steps; no UseAfterFreeError
tasks.success_signal: Memory footprint constant after prefill across all 100 steps (no growth per token)
tasks.notes: Highest ROI per minute. Must complete before QW-02 benchmark to get true memory baseline.

tasks.title: Implement dynamic KV cache sizing (exponential growth)
tasks.description: Replace fixed 512-token KV cache blocks with exponential growth: start 128 tokens, double when full. Reduces memory on short prompts by ~80%.
tasks.entry_criteria: Cache blocks are pre-allocated to fixed 512 tokens; prompt lengths vary 128-2048 tokens
tasks.exit_criteria: Cache starts at 128 tokens, reallocates at 2x when full; benchmarks show 60-80% memory savings on prompts <512 tokens
tasks.success_signal: Memory profile: short prompts <200MB (vs ~400MB), medium ~300MB, long full allocation; latency within 5% of QW-01 baseline
tasks.notes: Logic-only change; no GPU/async complications. Test immediately after QW-01 for true memory delta.

tasks.title: Parallelize model tokenizer fetch
tasks.description: Load multiple model tokenizers concurrently (fetch_tokenizer async + Promise.all) instead of sequential. Improves startup latency on multi-model workloads.
tasks.entry_criteria: Tokenizer loading is sequential in createSession or runtime initialization
tasks.exit_criteria: Tokenizers loaded with Promise.all; no race conditions on model switching; e2e latency measured
tasks.verification: deno task test:unit && deno task bench -- --models=lfm,gemma,maple --metric=session-init-latency
tasks.success_signal: Session init latency: multi-model ~100ms (vs 250ms sequential); single-model no regression
tasks.notes: Low risk change; existing async infrastructure. Independent of QW-01/02.

tasks.title: Profile WebGPU kernel dispatch and latency variance
tasks.description: Add WebGPU timing instrumentation to measure kernel dispatch overhead and p90/p99 jitter. Root-cause GPU latency variance (p90 = 2-3x p50).
tasks.entry_criteria: WebGPU latency is measured but no per-kernel breakdown; p90 latency unknown
tasks.exit_criteria: Kernel dispatch timing added; profiling report shows per-op latency distribution (p50/p90/p99); bottleneck identified
tasks.success_signal: Profiler identifies top 3 slowest kernels; p90/p99 variance <2x p50 after identifying jitter source
tasks.notes: Profiling task. Critical for M-02 buffer pool optimization. Can run in parallel with M-02, M-03, M-05 (informational, not blocking).

tasks.title: Implement persistent WebGPU buffer pools
tasks.description: Create reusable buffer pool to avoid repeated alloc/dealloc during inference. Reduces kernel dispatch jitter by ~20-30%.
tasks.entry_criteria: WebGPU buffers allocated per inference pass; no reuse across steps
tasks.exit_criteria: Buffer pool implemented with pre-allocation, LRU eviction; latency jitter reduced by 20-30%; no memory growth
tasks.success_signal: p90 latency reduced to <1.5x p50 (from 2-3x); buffer pool hit rate >90%
tasks.notes: Complements M-01 profiling. Implementation-only, doesn't require profiling results to start. Can parallelize M-01.

tasks.title: Create INT8 post-training quantization loader
tasks.description: Implement safetensors INT8 weight loader (bitsandbytes-style). Reduces model memory by 50%, increases throughput by ~2x with minimal accuracy loss.
tasks.entry_criteria: Safetensors loader exists but loads only FP32; quantized weights not supported
tasks.exit_criteria: INT8 loader implemented; scales/zeros format understood; all models load correctly quantized; no accuracy drop >0.5%
tasks.verification: deno task test:unit -- quantization && deno task bench -- --model=gemma --quantize=int8 --metric=throughput,accuracy
tasks.success_signal: Throughput 1.8-2.2x baseline; memory 50% reduction; perplexity delta <0.5% on benchmark
tasks.notes: No retraining required (post-training). Pre-quantized weights assumed to exist. Orthogonal to M-02/M-01.

tasks.title: Implement KV cache paging (continuous batching)
tasks.description: Replace per-layer KV block design with paged continuous buffer. Supports longer prompts (8K+), enables batch prefill. Workaround for jax-js UseAfterFreeError on long sequences.
tasks.entry_criteria: KV cache stored as per-layer blocks; fixed allocation; UseAfterFreeError on long prompts
tasks.exit_criteria: Paged continuous buffer implemented; allocation on-demand; 8K+ prompts unblocked; memory utilization >85%
tasks.verification: deno task test:unit -- kv-paging && deno task bench -- --model=gemma --prompt-length=2048,4096,8192 --metric=throughput
tasks.success_signal: 8K+ prompts work without UseAfterFreeError; memory overhead <5% vs dynamic sizing; throughput stable
tasks.notes: Major architectural change. Can prototype after QW-02 to inform design. Integration test required with M-03.

tasks.title: Activate WASM SIMD backend
tasks.description: Enable WASM SIMD128 instructions in Deno runtime; provides 3-5x CPU speedup on non-GPU paths (prefill WASM fallback). Switch backend routing logic.
tasks.entry_criteria: WASM SIMD available but not enabled; backend selector defaults to WebGPU only
tasks.exit_criteria: SIMD128 instructions used; backend selector routes to WASM for prefill on CPU; latency measured
tasks.success_signal: WASM prefill 3-5x faster than baseline WASM; GPU backend unchanged; no regressions
tasks.notes: Platform-specific optimization. Requires Deno WASM SIMD support (check version). Independent of all other medium tasks.

tasks.title: Integration: Quantization + KV paging cross-model benchmark
tasks.description: Verify M-03 (INT8 quantization) + M-04 (KV paging) work together. Run comprehensive benchmark across all models with various prompt lengths. Measure memory, latency, throughput.
tasks.entry_criteria: M-03 and M-04 individually passing; benchmark harness can run combinations
tasks.exit_criteria: Benchmark matrix complete (all models × quantize on/off × cache mode × prompt length); no unexpected interactions
tasks.success_signal: All combinations stable; memory + latency within expected cumulative improvements (not regressed); no race conditions
tasks.notes: Integration gatekeeper. Must pass before releasing M-03 + M-04 to long-term phases.

tasks.title: Implement UseAfterFreeError workaround for long prompts
tasks.description: Add reference counting workaround or buffer copying in jax-js layer to prevent UseAfterFreeError on 8K+ token sequences. Unblocks long-context inference without upstream fix.
tasks.entry_criteria: UseAfterFreeError occurs on prompts >8K tokens; upstream jax-js issue not fixed
tasks.exit_criteria: Workaround applied; 8K+ prompts no longer crash; memory overhead <10%
tasks.success_signal: 8K+ prompts complete without UseAfterFreeError; inference output valid
tasks.notes: Blocks long-context features (L-02, L-03). High priority. Can start in parallel, must complete before L-02.

tasks.title: Implement distributed tensor parallelism (base)
tasks.description: Distribute model weights across multiple GPUs using tensor parallelism. Base implementation for 2-4 GPUs. Enables 4-8x throughput on inference.
tasks.entry_criteria: Single-GPU inference stable; UseAfterFreeError workaround in place; multi-GPU architecture designed
tasks.exit_criteria: Tensor parallelism implemented for LM head and embedding layers; 2-4 GPU support; allreduce/allgather kernels working
tasks.verification: deno task test:unit -- distributed && deno task bench -- --devices=2,4 --metric=throughput-scaling
tasks.success_signal: Throughput scales 1.8-3.5x on 2-4 GPUs (vs 4-8x ideal); no communication bottleneck >20% overhead
tasks.notes: High complexity. Depends on L-01 (UseAfterFree fix). Can start after L-01 completes. Requires multi-GPU testing environment.

tasks.title: Implement LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning adapter wrapper
tasks.description: Wrap quantized models with LoRA low-rank adapters. Enables 10x faster fine-tuning on INT8 quantized weights. Minimal memory overhead.
tasks.entry_criteria: Quantization loader (M-03) complete; TrainingRunner exists; models loaded with INT8
tasks.exit_criteria: LoRA adapter layer wraps quantized models; fine-tuning works; memory overhead <15%
tasks.verification: deno task test:unit -- lora && deno task bench -- --model=gemma --lora=true --metric=training-throughput
tasks.success_signal: Fine-tuning 10x faster with LoRA; accuracy within 0.5% of full fine-tuning; inference latency unchanged
tasks.notes: Depends on M-03 (quantization). Orthogonal to L-02. Can parallelize with L-02 after both prerequisites met.

tasks.title: Implement MoE expert load-balancing (Maple model)
tasks.description: Activate expert load-balancing logic for Maple MoE model. Route tokens to least-loaded experts. Enables sparse activation, 2-3x speedup on Maple inference.
tasks.entry_criteria: Maple model support exists; expert layers defined; routing not optimized
tasks.exit_criteria: Load-balanced routing implemented; token distribution monitored; sparse activation working
tasks.success_signal: Expert load within 10% of ideal (balanced); sparse activation 2-3x speedup on Maple vs dense
tasks.notes: Model-specific. Depends on L-01 (error fixes). Independent of L-02/L-03 but benefits from L-02 distributed backend.

tasks.title: Implement speculative decoding with draft models
tasks.description: Use smaller draft model to generate k tokens, verify with main model. 2-3x decode speedup with minimal accuracy loss. Requires draft model weights.
tasks.entry_criteria: Main + draft models loaded; distributed backend stable (L-02); UseAfterFree fix in place
tasks.exit_criteria: Speculative decoding pipeline implemented; token verification logic working; speedup measured
tasks.success_signal: Decode 2-3x faster with speculation; accuracy unchanged (no false accepts); main model output unchanged
tasks.notes: Depends on L-02 (distributed backend helps with dual-model loading). High complexity. Last long-term task.

tasks.title: End-to-end performance validation suite
tasks.description: Comprehensive validation: all optimizations together, no regressions. Benchmark all models across all modes. Report final 5-8x speedup claim.
tasks.entry_criteria: All long-term tasks complete; benchmark harness supports all features
tasks.exit_criteria: Comprehensive benchmark report generated; speedup targets met; no regressions vs quick wins
tasks.success_signal: Overall speedup 5-8x; all optimizations composable; no unexpected interactions; ready for production release
tasks.notes: Final gatekeeper. Ships the release. Runs after all long-term tasks.
